correctionReview.rationale: The source guide names the 1988 series for the first ongoing Wolverine run and the 2003, 2010, 2013 and 2014 series for later runs, but authoring resolved several references to the wrong volume and then folded the displaced references into them as repeats or exclusions. Each listed position now carries the volume its own source line names, or for source line 388 the Jason Aaron run that line's collection names, with its issue id read from the live metadata service. No other position, gap, placeholder, section or order changed. Saved reading lists are snapshots of issue ids and read marks are keyed by issue id, so lists readers saved before this correction keep their rows and progress.
